issue_request: FHIR-16810 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab STU3 change request asking that ValueSet.expansion.identifier explain that "this expansion" identifies the expansion set produced from a particular set of supplied parameters, defaults, and code system versions, not merely one server response instance.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN revision 14729. Git commit 8e7233ebf523e4bd9426d2b82a3a485f8ddf6fa4, 'GF#16810 - clarify definition', has git-svn-id build@14729 and changed the ValueSet source definition to include provided parameters, system default parameters, and underlying code system versions as the expansion identity factors.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini and source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml is current build input. The historical spreadsheet source was later migrated/refactored into StructureDefinition XML while preserving the FHIR-16810 wording. FHIR-16442 separately handled the same element's short display text, and FHIR-55363 later confirmed no change is needed to make the same identifier repeat.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current definition says the identifier uniquely identifies the expansion based on the unique combination of provided parameters, system default parameters, and underlying code system versions, and that systems may reuse the identifier while those factors and the expansion remain the same.
